rig.scope: Original closed five-digit geometry and source UV/materials are retained. Additional joints/weights only. This does not certify anatomical final quality, contact, self-collision or force-closure grasping.
rig.coordinates: Original study bind units, Y up, +Z front. Not a calibrated physical metre scale.

sourceCoordinateContract: Uncalibrated study units. Y up, +Z front. Same source bind/local frame; no metre conversion.
materialContract: Unlit Float32 linear vertex COLOR, FrontSide. No image map/UV is needed for repaired hands. Godot defaults may quantize COLOR; use source runtime CUSTOM0 float path.
integration: Hand-only package, not whole avatar. Remap original body joints by name onto source body22; add 30 finger bones with supplied revised bind/rest and weight indices. Do not apply a second .1775Z offset. Preserve original hand mesh matrix/bind frame.

approval.localVisual: Root reported macro proportions improved; complete quality not approved

driveContract.curl: Each digit uses clamp(individual[name] ?? grip ?? 0,0,1). No smoothing or hidden clipping beyond range; UI adds its individual slider to global grip before this function.
driveContract.deltaOrder: local restQuaternion * (thumb MCP Rz(sign*.55*opposition)*Ry(sign*.55*opposition) if thumb MCP) * Rx(maxFlexDegrees[k]*curl)
driveContract.bodyPoseRule: Existing body22 motion untouched. Treat delta above as pose relative to each new finger bone actual bind/rest; do not multiply rest twice in a Godot pose delta API.
driveContract.limits: Per-digit maxFlexDegrees in rig.hands. No force or collision response and no arbitrary-pose guarantee.
